scientific_role: full-month runner integrity and resource-feasibility pilot

timing.cache_regime: warm cache within one DuckDB connection per unit

admission_gates: all four layers produce one relational result digest per unit
both lineage-enabled layers produce one source-edge digest per unit
complete-layer certificates remain PARTIAL without diagnostics
input row counts and artifact hashes match the frozen manifest
DuckDB profiling records peak buffer memory and temporary spill bytes
the measurement uses a clean committed Git snapshot
decision_policy: A PASS admits a separately frozen formal full-month timing protocol.
This three-block pilot cannot itself authorize publication latency claims.
Any spill is retained and used to size the formal memory protocol; it is not silently deleted.
The evidence is source-snapshot lineage only, not record-level lineage.
The frozen optimizer is not refitted, rerun, or reopened.
